zh: n最大10^12，不能枚举每个k。注意floor(n/k)随k增大而不增，相同的商出现在一段连续的k上。
对当前k，商q=floor(n/k)，能得到同一个商的最大k是floor(n/q)。整段只需把q加一次，然后直接跳到floor(n/q)+1。这样不同的商最多约2√n个。
k=1，answer=0；当k≤n时：q=n/k（整除），answer加q，k=n/q+1。n=0时循环不执行，答案为0。结果在64位整数范围内。
en: n can be as large as 10^12, so you cannot try every k. Note that floor(n/k) never increases as k grows, so equal quotients appear over a contiguous range of k.

For the current k with quotient q=floor(n/k), the largest k giving the same quotient is floor(n/q). Add q once for the whole range and jump straight to floor(n/q)+1. There are at most about 2√n distinct quotients this way.
Set k=1 and answer=0; while k≤n: q=n/k (integer division), add q to answer, and set k=n/q+1. When n=0 the loop does not run and the answer is 0. The result fits in a 64-bit integer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Start from k=1. The last divisor that gives the same current quotient q=n//k is n//q; add q once, then jump past that range.

## Proof of correctness

The quotient never increases as k grows, and the contiguous range with quotient q ends at the largest k with floor(n/k)=q, namely k=n//q. Skipping the whole range adds q only once and misses no other positive quotient; for k>n every quotient is 0, so there is no need to enumerate further. Hence the sum of the distinct quotients is computed exactly. There are only √n small divisors ≤√n, and the large divisors give quotients ≤√n, so there are at most √n distinct values there as well.

## Complexity

Time O(√n), extra space O(1).
